notes.title: Update #1: Fixed Issues
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are enjoying the game. Today, I have received a message which stated that there was a problem using arrow keys for player's movement. I decided to fix the bug and provide an update as soon as possible. 

Finally, I have finished fixing the bug and from now on, the player's movement can be controlled using arrow keys in addition to WASD keys. I also have fixed some minor technical issues today. 

If you have any suggestion or idea to improve the game or if you encounter any further issues please let me know either through the discussion section or through the support email. Thank you very much for your patience!

I will provide a few more updates in the future and keep fixing the bugs.

Best Regards,
Anamik
